The '''explorer craft''' was a rocket-powered spacecraft also capable of atmospheric flight.

==History==
Similar to the [[YT-XC]], one of these vessels was carried aboard the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']]. [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] once used the ''Falcon''{{'s}} explorer craft to rescue his son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpy]] from the dangerous [[Shadowlands/Legends|lower forests]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].
